name: product-recap
description: Turn one or more repos' git history into a product-evolution story and a single-file HTML slide deck. Run from any directory; always recaps the canonical master branch. A local clone is mined only when it's on master; if it's on another branch, or cwd is not a repo (resolve the repo from natural language against the Mercaso org), it reads master from the remote instead. Merge sibling repos into one deck, scope to a sub-path, pick a time window (open-ended or a closed range); verify flows in code, narrate for non-engineers, build and visually verify the deck.
